t: What do you have to tell me?

Studying the mysteries of the world is my primary objective.  You have no idea how many uncovered mysteries are out there, in Sarnaut. And as we reveal them, we will not only learn about our past, but we will know how to plan for our future.
If you happen to solve some mysteries over the course of your travels, make sure to come see me. Remember that you will be generously rewarded for your efforts. I hope that we'll be seeing each other often. Travel safe!
You have solved the "Ancient June Magic" mystery

The mystery of the ancient June ruins has been solved! They can be used to tap into the ancient teleportation network and travel between the strange devices. The Adventurer's Stone now allows its owner to move quickly between neighboring allods. It is a wondrous device, indeed!

You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Selene de Ardeur on Evermeet Isle (Level 4). Once you are done with your task, speak with Hugues de Delice in Novograd to complete it (Level 6).

Slow down, I don't want to miss any details!
Alright, so a certain Miroslav Kramolsky had managed to pass himself off as a descendant of the Valir. He then took advantage of the Kanian nobility's discontent with the new age to instigate a rebellion. Thanks to the persistence and selflessness of ordinary League citizens like yourself, the rebellion was subdued, the lie exposed, and the impostor killed.
Kania is being torn apart by rebellion! You must find out its cause, expose the ringleaders, and put an end to the discord.
Phew, there are so many twists in this story! I'm sure you had to run around quite a bit in order to solve this mystery. And for that you deserve a reward!
You have solved the "Kanian Rebellion" mystery
The letter taken from Danil Remizov in Lightwood starts this stage of the World Mystery (Level 9). Once you are done with your task, speak with Pavel Isaev in Novograd to complete it (Level 10).

quests: Putting it All on the Line

t: It appears that the Kanian rebels are desperate to achieve their goal - desperate enough to ally themselves with the League's mortal enemy! Their first attempt to take advantage of the Empire's help has failed, but who knows what the future holds...
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Vladimir Zalesky in Lightwood (Level 11). Once you are done with your task, speak with Aidenus in Novograd to complete it (Level 11).

The Kanian rebels continue to do anything to get what they want. At this point, things are headed towards an open civil war! You must expose their leader who is known only by the initials W. K. If he's defeated, the rebel activities would be crippled.
The letter received from Somber Family in Siveria starts this step of the World Mystery (Level 13). Once you are done with your task, speak with Georgi Vityazev to complete it (Level 15).
You can start this stage by speaking with Izbor Yavorsky in Novograd at level 18. It leads to Darkwater and Castle Blight. Speak with Dobrinya Nikitov in Darkwater to complete it at level 22.

quests: The Fate of the Wagon Train
From the Frying Pan into the Fire
A Strike Against the Winged Folk

t: For many a year now, the Gibberlings have been searching for Isa - their lost homeland. Unfortunately, the hope of finding it lessens with each day. The Gibberlings need some help or else they'll be doomed to perish, like a tree that has lost its roots.

It looks like we can congratulate the Gibberlings for finding their homeland. However, it's not like they need it. Frozen Frontier is full of celebrations right now!
All that remains is for me to record this epic tale. With the loss of their historic homeland, the Gibberlings did not despair. By calling upon the Great Dragon and the heroes of the League, the little people started to transform the harsh winter region into a flourishing garden. How wonderful!
You have solved the "Lost Homeland" mystery
You can start this stage by speaking with the Gray Family in Novograd at level 10. It leads to Lightwood. Speak with the Gray Family in Novograd to complete it at level 11.

Alas, the tidings are quite sad! The Gibberling scouts that searched for Isa have died. Before their death, they said that the Gibberling homeland was gone forever. No one knows if the Gibberlings will survive the destruction of their hopes and dreams.
You can start this stage by speaking with the Gray Family in Novograd at level 12. Speak with Froddy the Fidget at Frozen Frontier to complete it at level 14.

quests: On the Trail of the Spy

t: You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Froddy the Fidget at Frozen Frontier (Level 17). Once you are done with your task, speak with Veleslav Kapishev in Darkwater to complete it (Level 18).

quests: A Garden City Shall Stand Here
An Artifact the Color of Ice

t: Now the Gibberlings' fate is clear! They have the opportunity to melt the eternal frosts of Frozen Frontier and turn it into a blooming garden. Who knows, maybe someday this snowy archipelago will change not only in appearance, but also in name. The League maps may one day show these allods as New Isa.
You can start this stage by speaking with Veleslav Kapishev in Darkwater at level 19. It leads to Castle Blight. Speak with the Keen Family in Darkwater to complete it at level 22.

quests: For the Good of the Great Tree

t: The Elves are a mysterious people, indeed. Unraveling their riddles is a difficult task.
You have solved the "Great Game" mystery
You can start this stage by speaking with Pavel Isaev in Novograd at level 9. It leads to Lightwood. Speak with Pierre de Ardeur in Novograd to complete it at level 11.

quests: The Search for an Elven Wizard: Southern Birchwoods

t: Not much has been cleared up at all. All we know so far is that the House de Desirae, who had won the last Great Game, has accused the Elves of the de Doucer family of cheating. The de Doucer Elves have been disgraced, and the winners are doing everything in their power to persecute them.

You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Pierre de Desirae in Novograd (Level 12). Once you are done with your task, speak with Avery de Grandeur in Siveria to complete it (Level 15).

While carrying out the Elves' task, you managed to witness a mysterious magic ritual in which the sculptor of the House de Doucer used some strange magic connected to the Astral. Could this be what the Elves of the House de Desirae warned you about? You should find a way to contact them.

You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Pierre de Desirae in Novograd (Level 18). Once you are done with your task, speak with Ivan Gubarevsky in Darkwater to complete it (Level 20).

The letter received from Frederic de Ardeur at Tenebra starts this stage of the World Mystery (Level 21). Once you are done with your task, speak with Dakkar de Desirae in Castle Blight to complete it (Level 22).

quests: An Audience with Marguerite de Desirae

t: You have solved the "Battle for the Holy Land" mystery

Good news and bad news always seem to go hand in hand. The good news is that Voisvet Belov entered the Temple and will surely be able to end the conflict with the Historians. The bad news is that the temple is filled with cultists. Additionally, a mysterious barrier has appeared that blocks access to most of the Temple.
You can start this stage by speaking with Stas Gorlanov in Asee-Teph at level 26. It leads to Tensess Temple. Speak with Klavdius Trojanov in Asee-Teph to complete it at level 27.

While Voisvet Belov is fighting within Tensess Temple, the war in the Holy Land continues to rage. There is no doubt that the League will eventually capture the Temple. Then the doctrines of the Church of Light can be proven correct and the world will recognize that Tensess is supreme.
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Miroslav Amvonov in Eljune (Level 30). Once you are done with your task, speak with this NPC again to complete it (Level 30).
You can start this stage by speaking with Nomarkh Semerkhet in Asee-Teph at level 35. It leads to Tensess Temple. Speak with Marianne de Ardeur in Novograd to complete it.

I'm sure the news about the first teleporter test will hit the headlines of all Imperial media tomorrow. Not to take anything away from the success of your mission!
By the way, I don't like the designation "teleporter". It doesn't sound good. So, what's the name that the scientist gave it? The Adventurer's Stone, isn't it? Yes, that's much better.

Oh, the new opportunities we face every day are simply breathtaking! If we go on like this, there will be no mysteries left in the world for us to discover quite soon. I will retire then.
There's still a long way to go. If you happen to discover anything interesting, come back to me. I'll be keeping a detailed record of all mysteries, and besides, you can expect a good reward! See you soon.
You have solved the "Science at the Service of Empire" mystery

The tests have been successfully completed! The Adventurer's Stone now allows its owner to use the ancient June ruins to access the teleportation trails. They move the user from one ruin to another and provide complete protection from the Astral. It is a wondrous device, indeed!
You can start this stage by speaking with Pavel Nakhimin at Cloud Nine Health Resort at level 4. Speak with Sarbaz Raemka in Nezebgrad to complete it at level 7.
Your eye-openers will pale in comparison to the government secrets I have access to. Now what is it you have to tell me?
You have solved the "Xadaganian Ambitions" mystery
You can start this stage by speaking with Vera Chonkina in Nezebgrad at level 9. It leads to XAES. Speak with Elizaveta Rysina in Yasker's Tower to complete it at level 11.

quests: The Heart of the Power Plant

t: You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Elizaveta Rysina in Yasker's Tower at level 12. Speak with Larisa Nevolina in the Igsh Military District to complete it at level 13.

You can start this stage by speaking with Viktor Perov in the Igsh Military District at level 15. It leads to ZIT Headquarters. Speak with Elizaveta Rysina in Yasker's Tower to complete it at level 19.

The investigation has been finished. A secret laboratory has been busy working on a very ambitious project - taking control of Astral demons. There is no doubt that they will one day succeed. The Imperial people can do anything they set their minds to.
You can start this stage by speaking with Wrokag the Northwind in Yasker's Tower at level 22. It leads to Laboratory-13. Speak with Yasker in Yasker's Tower to complete it at level 23.
You have solved the "Hope of the Orcs" mystery

The Orcish shamans want to become independent from the Empire. They are currently searching for the descendants of the Legendary Orc, who supposedly wielded the power of the Great Mages long ago. Is it true or just a myth?
You can start this stage by speaking with Wire the Wily in Nezebgrad at level 9. Speak with Wrokag the Northwind in Yasker's Tower to complete it.
The first attempt to find the descendant of the Legendary Orc has failed - Voxar the Fierce is dead. But there's still hope!

You can start this stage by speaking with Wrokag the Northwind in Yasker's Tower at level 12. It leads to the Igsh Military District. Speak with Wrokag in Yasker's Tower again to complete it at level 14.

Strina the Fierce, a descendant of the Legendary Orc, has refused to cooperate with the shamans. Having revealed her exceptional magical talents and some slight dementia, the Orcish woman has fled. At the moment, it looks like the future of the Orcs will remain tied to that of the Empire.
You can start this stage by speaking with Wrokag the Northwind in Yasker's Tower at level 16. It leads to the Dead Sea. Speak with Wrokag in Yasker's Tower again to complete it at level 19.

quests: The Heiress of the Legendary Orc
The Choice of Strina the Fierce

t: Thanks to his talents Skulnar the Fierce, the third descendant of the Legendary Orc, was noticed by the City Council and turned into an experimental subject. However, there's still hope that Skulnar could be rescued.
You can start this stage by speaking with Wrokag the Northwind in Yasker's Tower at level 20. It leads to Wild Isles. Speak with Wrokag in Yasker's Tower again to complete it at level 21.
You can start this stage by speaking with Wrokag the Northwind in Yasker's Tower at level 22. It leads to Laboratory-13. Speak with Wrokag in Yasker's Tower again to complete it.

The Arisen owe their existence to an ancient crazed sorcerer by the name of Tep. He is their progenitor as well as their curse. The Arisen are currently searching for his whereabouts for few believe that Tep is dead.
You have solved the "Eternal Enemy" mystery

Studying the heritage of Tep, the forefather of the Arisen, is one of the main tasks of the Arisen Historians. Why is it that they're so interested in this? A thirst for knowledge? A desire to know what happened to Tep—and to get even, in case he lived? Or maybe it's just the fear of a dreadful and mighty enemy?
You can start this stage by speaking with Sarang Ahhotep in Nezebgrad at level 11. Speak with Nomarkh Khabash in the Igsh Military District to complete it at level 13.

The incident that transpired at the ZIT Headquarters has effectively answered the main question of the Arisen. Tep is alive! Not only that, he appears to be just as devious and powerful as ever. The mad necromancer may prove to be a threat to the entire world!
You can start this stage by speaking with Sarbaz Renseneb at ZIT Headquarters at level 15. Speak with Negus Kheket in Yasker's Tower to complete it at level 16.

quests: The Main Secret of the Pyramid

t: While investigating the circumstances of the strange events on the bottom of the Dead Sea, new traces of Tep have been discovered. It appears that he is interested not only in the activities of the ZIT, but also in the power of Tensess' Gift.
You can start this stage by speaking with Solka the Unyielding at the Dead Sea at level 18. Speak with Negus Kheket in Yasker's Tower to complete it at level 19.

quests: He Left and Never Came Back
The Dance of the Black Shadows

t: The fears of the Arisen are justified! Tep is just as dangerous and unpredictable as ever! He has many followers and informants to keep track of everything that's happening in the world, and he jumps at any opportunity to grow stronger. Sooner or later he will reveal himself to the world once more, and there will be no choice but to fight him!
You can start this stage by speaking with Elizaveta Rysina in Yasker's Tower at level 22. It leads to Laboratory-13. Speak with Negus Kheket in Yasker's Tower to complete it.
You have solved the "Battle for the Holy Land" mystery

Good news and bad news always seem to go hand in hand. The good news is that Nefer Ur entered the Temple and will surely be able to end the conflict with the Historians. The bad news is that the temple is filled with cultists. Additionally, a mysterious barrier has appeared that blocks access to most of the Temple.
You can start this stage by speaking with Kirill Sechin in Asee-Teph at level 26. It leads to Tensess Temple. Speak with Anatoly Aldanov in Asee-Teph to complete it at level 27.

quests: Plan of Attack: the Second Phase
Plan of Attack: the Third Phase
Plan of Attack: the Fourth Phase

t: While Nefer Ur is fighting within Tensess Temple, the war in the Holy Land continues to rage. There is no doubt that the Empire will eventually capture the Temple. Then the doctrines of the Trinity Church can be proven correct and the world will recognize the glory of Nezeb and Skrakan.
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Irina Lazareva in Eljune (Level 30). Once you are done with your task, speak with this NPC again to complete it (Level 30).
You can start this stage by speaking with Nomarkh Semerkhet in Asee-Teph at level 35. It leads to Tensess Temple. Speak with Elizaveta Rysina in Yasker's Tower to complete it.

quests: The Search for Nefer Ur Continues

t: Do you have something to tell me? Something that will allow us to end this Imperial heresy?

The main ideological difference between the League and the Empire is the source of holy energy. The Imperial heretics will do anything to justify their right to use holy magic. Because of this dispute, the Holy Land have become the grounds for an ideological war. It's time to put an end to these arguments and find the true source of the Light!
You have solved the "Power of the Light" mystery
Faith is a weapon as dangerous as the sword. The League has been fighting the Imperial ideology for ages. The Empire must be made to accept the truth.
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Gorislav Kovchegov in Asee-Teph (Level 23). Once you are done with your task, speak with this NPC again to complete it (Level 27).

The power of the Light is being threatened! Wicked cultists have been trying to warp it to their own ends. They have recently been very active in Coba Plateau, a place filled with mysterious artifacts. It is here that a war is taking place, but it's not being fought over the ancient treasures. It's being fought to save every soul in Sarnaut. We need the Inquisition to scorch no only the Imperial heresy, but fight the pristine Darkness.

You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Zosim Nikulin in Eljune (Level 31). Once you are done with your task, speak with Afanasy Firov on Coba Plateau to complete it (Level 31).
You can start this stage by speaking with Gorislav Kovchegov in Asee-Teph at level 35. It leads to Tensess Temple. Speak with Aidenus in Novograd to complete it.
What do you have to tell me? Did the League finally acknowledge their mistakes?
You have solved the "Power of the Light" mystery
Faith is a weapon as dangerous as the sword. The struggle with the lies of the League Priests has lasted for ages. The Empire can no longer wait! The battle for the truth must be won.
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Vlada Merinova in Asee-Teph (Level 23). Once you are done with your task, speak with this NPC again to complete it (Level 27).

The power of the Light is being threatened! Wicked cultists have been trying to warp it to their own ends. They have recently been very active in Coba Plateau, a place filled with mysterious artifacts. It is here that a war is taking place, but it's not being fought over the ancient treasures. It's being fought to save every soul in Sarnaut. Which makes it the Empire's responsibility.
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Zosim Nikulin in Eljune (Level 31). Once you are done with your task, speak with Semer Kiya on Coba Plateau to complete it (Level 31).
The truth is that the power of the Light is not contained in Tensess, Skrakan, or Nezeb. Instead, it originates from the belief that Sarnaut's inhabitants have in it. Perhaps this is for the best.
You can start this stage by speaking with Vlada Merinova in Asee-Teph at level 35. It leads to Tensess Temple. Speak with Yasker in Nezebgrad to complete it.
You look very serious... do you have something important to say?
You have solved the "Strange Cultists" mystery

The Holy Land has become a place of battle for not only the League and the Empire, but demon worshippers as well. The cultists are playing their own incomprehensible game by desecrating the Sites of Power. They need to be stopped and their reasons revealed.

You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Stas Gorlanov in Asee-Teph (Level 25). Once you are done with your task, speak with Esther de Desirae in Asee-Teph to complete it (Level 26).
It seems that the attention of the cultists is not only focused on the Sites of Power. Wherever possible they instill fear and darkness. Even the smallest allods of Sarnaut will not be safe.

You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Shysh the Wind in Eljune (Level 30). Once you are done with your task, speak with Beech the Thickskinned in Eljune to complete it (Level 30).

The letter taken from Vissarion Arhivin in Tensess Temple starts this stage of the World Mystery (Level 35). Once you are done with your task, speak with Izbor Yavorsky in Novograd to complete it (Level 35).
The blow from the cultists to Tensess Temple was not fatal. However, a strange Orc named Strina the Fierce has joined the cultists and is using her necromantic powers to destroy Coldberg.

You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Wickham the Sharp in Coldberg (Level 34). Once you are done with your task, speak with Kurgan the Crafty in Coldberg to complete it (Level 36).

The allod of Avilon is one more place that the de Doucer vampires have attempted to destroy. After joining with the cultists, they used the power of an Elven Galleon to wreak havoc. There is one more strange thing that has happened - Gorluxor's name is still mentioned by the cultists despite his death in Tensess Temple.
You can start this stage by speaking with Marianne de Ardeur in Novograd at level 36. It leads to Avilon. Speak with Izbor Yavorsky in Novograd to complete it at level 37.
In Dragon Ring a great battle began between the dragons of Soliskar's brood and the risen Gorluxor. The necromancer was defeated once again, but who can guarantee that this is a true victory?
You can start this stage by speaking with Izbor Yavorsky in Novograd at level 37. It leads to Dragon Ring. Speak with Izbor Yavorsky in Novograd to complete it at level 38.

quests: Two Heads Aren't Better Than One
Don't Come Back Without Any Heads!

t: A visit to Gorluxor's Tower has led to a surprising discovery. Gorluxor is not the cultists' leader! There are very few clues as to the identity of the true Master. The brief encounter has revealed that his power is seemingly limitless.

You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Stas Gorlanov in Asee-Teph (Level 45). Once you are done with your task, speak with Esther de Desirae in Asee-Teph to complete it (Level 45).

You can start this stage by speaking with Crazystorm the Merciless in Yasker's Tower at level 37. It leads to Dragon Ring. Speak with Crazystorm in Yasker's Tower again to complete it at level 38.

You can start this stage of the World Mystery after obtaining a Magical Chain at Gorluxor's Tower (Level 45). Once you are done with your task, speak with Yasker in Nezebgrad to complete it (Level 45).
What is the secret that shall be revealed this time?

Who are they, these devils of darkness? The Astral predators that seek to destroy the world, sowing terror and death? Are they creatures from another world? Or new monsters born from Astral mutations? This mystery will continue to plague the inhabitants of Sarnaut until it is solved.
You have solved the "Demonic Threat" mystery

You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Stas Gorlanov in Asee-Teph (Level 24). Once you are done with your task, speak with Esther de Desirae in Asee-Teph to complete it (Level 24).

quests: A Gift For the League Defenders

t: Some people are now doubting that the victory from the Great Astral Campaign is complete. Is the battle still not over? Does the demonic threat persist?
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Mikhail Selyaninov in Eljune (Level 28). Once you are done with your task, speak with this NPC again to complete it (Level 31).

quests: Return From the Edge of Eternal Night

t: The Demon Hunters are tireless soldiers, fighting off the astral threat. They don't want to believe that the demons have been defeated. Are they right? Or could it be a ploy to keep the Demon Hunters from losing their influence after the end of the Great Astral Campaign?

You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Anastasia Leshcheva on Coba Plateau (Level 34). Once you are done with your task, speak with Esther de Desirae in Asee-Teph to complete it (Level 35).

Tensess, the fallen Great Mage, has called upon the League and the Empire to unite in the war against the demons. He has warned that the Great Astral Campaign is not yet complete. There is still much work to be done.
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Voisvet Belov in Tensess Temple (Level 35). Once you are done with your task, speak with Aidenus in Novograd to complete it (Level 35).

The veterans of the Great Astral Campaign have agreed with Tensess and are ready to unite once again. A new city full of demons has been discovered on Yazes Shard and it appears that they're planning another invasion. They must be stopped before they can get the first strike!
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Svarog Linev at Yazes Shard (Level 38). Once you are done with your task, speak with Aidenus in Novograd to complete it (Level 39).
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Aidenus in Novograd (Level 40). Once you are done with your task, speak with him again to complete it (Level 40).
You can start this stage by speaking with Aidenus in Novograd at level 45. It leads to Demons' City. Speak with Aidenus in Novograd to complete it.

quests: The Supreme Leader of the Cultists

You can start this stage by speaking with Yasker in Yasker's Tower at level 45. It leads to Demons' City. Speak with Yasker in Yasker's Tower again to complete it.
Ah, it's you! I trust you have another secret to tell me?

There is no better catalyst for progress than war! And there is nothing surprising about the fact that the war for the Holy Land gave birth to some holy weapons. What will this mean for the Empire? Self-destruction, or a long-awaited victory?
You have solved the "Holy Weapons" mystery

There's no doubt that these so-called "holy weapons" are extremely powerful. They could be capable of deciding the outcome of the war for the Holy Land once and for all. The only question is, how can the Empire be prevented from getting them?

You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Klavdius Trojanov in Asee-Teph (Level 27). Once you are done with your task, speak with Peppy Family in Eljune to complete it (Level 28).
The goblins have been acting very suspiciously lately. Maybe, it works, or maybe, it doesn't. Perhaps this is just a scam after all? Do they aim to deceive the two great powers of Sarnaut?
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Peppy Family in Eljune (Level 30). Once you are done with your task, speak with Profka the Fierce in Eljune to complete it (Level 30).

The former "holy weapons" have now been transformed into dark artifacts by cultists in Coba Plateau. The cultists have joined forces with some of the Historians and they tried to spread the darkness. The Empire also experimented on the dark artifacts. Luckily for the League, they failed.

t: How is your search going? Have you managed to find something out about the mysterious "experiment"?
You have solved the "Grand Experiment" mystery

You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Maria Zavetina on Wandering Island (Level 48). Once you are done with your task, speak with Keeper of Knowledge on the Isle of Revelation to complete it (Level 48).
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Klavdia Kalugina in the Irdrich ruins (Level 53). Once you are done with your task, speak with this NPC again to complete it (Level 53).

The Grand Experiment was the unsuccessful attempt of the Great Mages to conquer the astral and obtain limitless power. The Spark of the Great Mage released from Tep's Pyramid told us about the old documents that confirm this assumption.

The Cataclysm that caused splitting of Sarnaut into allods was a consequence of Mages' arrogance. They thought themselves equal to gods. They paid a price, and still are paying. Should we be telling ordinary people about it? Should we stir up the past, or is it best to think about the future and, with the knowledge we gained about the experiment, try saving what can be saved?
